name: trip-glance
title: Trip Glance
description: A plane flies along a line that curves down to its destination, a white trail behind and green ahead.

perf.budget: The plane and trail run on one UI-thread spring when progress changes. One small view ripples at the destination until arrival.

a11y.reducedMotion: The plane jumps to its place, the time does not count and the destination does not ripple.
a11y.screenReader: One progress bar ("KN81 to OSL. 2 hours 56 minutes left. Landing early. 2 bags").
